topic_title: Emergency Control: Skids, Blowouts & Brake Failure
prompt: If your service brake pedal sinks completely to the floorboards without stopping, what initial action should you take?

options.text: Turn off vehicle ignition key immediately to lock steering column in place
Pump brake pedal rapidly to rebuild hydraulic pressure and downshift to lower gear
Shift quickly to reverse to force engine rotation to counter momentum
Climb into passenger seat and wait for friction to halt the rolling chassis
